    Morning briefing

    The share column ships flat at the room's median - 10 names, 1 of them short, their order an unshipped shadow (R81) - and the option column ships the room's own G_OPTION median on 10 legs (R79; the owner's ten a day - 0 DESK-FILLED, 6 R4-OVERFLOW (owner, 2026-10-06) at half stake), led by WMT 2026-10-23 $120C at 50.5; watchdog sits suspended on a congressional feed that still serves no record count, and the board sat after the open

    Mandate: Mix (any). OVERNIGHT: Asia's last bars are stale 2026-10-15 closes and red (KOSPI -7.57%, Nikkei 225 -4.90%, Shanghai -1.59%, Hang Seng -1.03%); Europe closed up (DAX +0.95%, Euro Stoxx 50 +0.58%, FTSE 100 +0.38%); US futures sat down into the open (S&P -1.18%, Nasdaq 100 -2.48%). Asia and the futures agree; Europe is the dissent. Expected shape: a straight session - the gap-up opens failed and sold into the freeze (TSLA, PLTR, CRWD, PANW, CRM, MSFT all traded through their opening windows), and I expect no reclaim of the morning level into the close, not a morning move that retraces and then reclaims. Where the conviction sits: ONE bet expressed twice - defensive rotation over AI hardware. Nine of ten share lines are longs in staples, healthcare and value names with the one short on AI storage, and nine of ten option legs are calls led by the same rotation (WMT, AAPL, KO, GILD, XOM, LMT); that is correlation, not breadth, and I rank it as one bet. What invalidates it: the rotation reversing - QQQ reclaiming while the defensives give back - which the falsifier scores on the top three lines; the cycle composite (+2.81% over 10 sessions, 126d troughing) and the neural net's +18% to +20% on STX, CRWD, SMCI, WDC and PANW are the served arguments for exactly that reversal, and the room rejects both. Calibration: no seat earns weight - the best trailing grade-return correlation is Graham's +0.047, the worst the Sam's -0.180 - so share lines file at the one-median (R78/R86) and option legs ship the room's median (R79). No figure here is offered as skill (R146(d)). (3) WINDFALL - an option leg whose first served mark reaches 2x its premium at freeze banks half at that mark, on file the night it fires (R148); the other half rides to its own exit; a windfall not on file by the next freeze reads FAILED and nothing fills retroactively. Desk, R92/R12 - the memo's listings against the persisted book: share: DIFF PRINTED (R92); option: PASS
